ComposeFilePathInRepository.description: Path to the Stack file inside the Git repository

EdgeTemplate.description: EdgeTemplate indicates if this template purpose for Edge Stack

IsComposeFormat.description: IsComposeFormat indicates if the Kubernetes template is created from a Docker Compose file

Note.description: A note that will be displayed in the UI. Supports HTML content

Platform.description:
Platform associated to the template.
Valid values are: 1 - 'linux', 2 - 'windows'
Required for Docker stacks

RepositoryAuthentication.description: Use authentication to clone the Git repository

RepositoryAuthorizationType.description: RepositoryAuthorizationType is the authorization type to use

RepositoryGitCredentialID.description:
GitCredentialID used to identify the bound git credential. Required when RepositoryAuthentication
is true and RepositoryUsername/RepositoryPassword are not provided

RepositoryPassword.description:
Password used in basic authentication or token used in token authentication.
Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true and RepositoryGitCredentialID is 0

RepositoryReferenceName.description: Reference name of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryURL.description: URL of a Git repository hosting the Stack file

RepositoryUsername.description:
Username used in basic authentication. Required when RepositoryAuthentication is true
and RepositoryGitCredentialID is 0. Ignored if RepositoryAuthType is token

TLSSkipVerify.description: TLSSkipVerify skips SSL verification when cloning the Git repository

Type.description: Type of created stack (1 - swarm, 2 - compose, 3 - kubernetes)

Variables.description: Definitions of variables in the stack file
